player_prompt.intro:
I ye Player {player_id}. I ye Memory Game ye.
I tɛ a ye ka kɛlɛnkɛlenw bɛɛ a ra, ka kɔnɔw ma, o kɔrɔn.
I tɛ a ye anw wele, i ye ka kaartenw sɔrɔ masi kɛ, o kɔrɔn, ka masi kɛ '[0 1 1 0]', ka kaartenw ye kɔnɔ 0 anw masi 1, anw kaartenw kɔnɔ 1 anw masi 0.
I ka kaartenw bɛɛ a ra, i ye pointu kɛ, ka kaartenw ye a to. I ka kaartenw tɔgɔna, ka kaartenw ye a sɔrɔ, e.g. '.'.
Daŋɛ kɛlɛ, ka kɛlɛnkɛlenw bɛɛ a ra.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jatebla min tɛ waleya. Ɲinɛnbaa {player_id} ma jabi ni sira tilennen ye ka ɲɛsin fan fila la.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Jatebla {player_id} ye yɔrɔ sugandi min tɛ forobaciyɛn dan.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Jatebla tɛ waleya.Jatigi {player_id} ye kariti kelen sugandi siɲɛ fila.
invalid_move.already_matched: Jatebla ma bɛn.Jatigi {player_id} ye kariti kelen walima fila bɛɛ sugandi minnu tun ɲɔgonnen don ka ban.

game_message.cards_match: Kariw ka Player {player_id} bɔra kɔrɔ [{r1} {c1}] ani [{r2} {c2}] bɛ kelen!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kariw ka Player {player_id} bɔra tɛ kelen. Kariw kɔrɔ [{r1} {c1}] ani [{r2} {c2}] bɛ {pos1} ani {pos2} kɔrɔ kɔkɔ.

outcome.draw: Jula fila bɛɛ ye kariti hakɛ kelen kɛ.
outcome.turn_limit: Tɛmɛnɛ kɔnɔnɛ fla bɛɛ ka ta ka kɛnɛya. Jɛgɛ bɛɛ ka sɔrɔ. Jɛgɛ 0 ka kɛnɛya {score_0} kɛnɛya, Jɛgɛ 1 ka kɛnɛya {score_1} kɛnɛya.
